rationale: Price is sitting mid-range (48.2%) between today's open gap-down low and high, with the last five 1-minute candles showing a mild drift lower from ~65.83 to 65.56 but no clear directional conviction — volume is decelerating and price is oscillating around a tight band. The stock is below both VWAP ($65.89) and the 9-EMA ($65.81), which slightly favors the short side, but the gap-down of 6.6% on 5.78x relative volume suggests much of the move is already priced in and a mean-reversion bounce is equally plausible; without a clean structural level to lean against or a momentum break in either direction, the risk/reward is insufficient to commit capital.
